platformAdminLayout.title: Platform Admin Console
platformAdminLayout.description: Cross-organization: manage Group Admins, global tiers & quotas, right to erasure, and the platform audit trail. No access to any organization's content.

auditNarrative.userMfaReset: Reset MFA for {{role}} account {{target}} — must be set up again on next login.
auditNarrative.userActivationResent: Resent the activation link to Group Admin {{target}}.
auditNarrative.userBackupCodeUsed: Logged in using an MFA backup code (not the regular authenticator).
auditNarrative.groupTransferred: Transferred group management from {{target}} to another Group Admin.
auditNarrative.groupAssignedToExistingAdmin: Linked new group {{groupName}} to existing Group Admin account {{target}}.
auditNarrative.groupContractCreated: Created the initial contract for {{target}}'s group.
auditNarrative.tierCreated: Added new tier {{target}} to the catalog.
auditNarrative.tierArchiveStatusChanged: Changed tier {{target}}'s archive status from {{before}} to {{after}}.
auditNarrative.tierDeleted: Permanently deleted tier {{target}} from the catalog.
auditNarrative.sessionTimeoutChanged: Changed the session idle timeout from {{before}} to {{after}}.
auditNarrative.sessionTimeoutChangedGeneric: Changed the session idle timeout for own account.
auditNarrative.ipAllowlistEnabledChanged: Changed IP Allowlist enforcement from {{before}} to {{after}} (applies to all Platform Admin accounts).
auditNarrative.ipAllowlistEnabledChangedGeneric: Changed IP Allowlist enforcement on/off (applies to all Platform Admin accounts).
auditNarrative.ipAllowlistAdded: Added CIDR {{cidr}} to the allowed IP list (applies to all Platform Admin accounts).
auditNarrative.ipAllowlistAddedGeneric: Added a new entry to the allowed IP list (applies to all Platform Admin accounts).
auditNarrative.ipAllowlistRemoved: Removed CIDR {{cidr}} from the allowed IP list (applies to all Platform Admin accounts).
auditNarrative.ipAllowlistRemovedGeneric: Removed an entry from the allowed IP list (applies to all Platform Admin accounts).
auditNarrative.erasureExecuted: Executed Right to Erasure for {{target}} (pseudonymization, session revoke, MFA removal).
auditNarrative.erasureRejected: Rejected the Right to Erasure request for {{target}}.

legend.quotaText: = storage cap for a single group, not per organization. The Group Admin splits this cap across their orgs and cannot exceed it.
legend.retentionText: = how long operational data is kept after an organization is deactivated. The Group Admin picks a value within this range per organization.
legend.webhookSsoText: = outbound event limit per minute per organization and SSO availability. Changes to tier components apply to every Group Admin on that tier.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Tier from Catalog
deleteDialog.warning: A deleted tier can no longer be selected when registering a new Group Admin. This action cannot be undone.

form.footerNote: Changes apply to every Group Admin on this tier.

erasureRequestsPage.eyebrow: Right to Erasure · UU PDP Article 43
erasureRequestsPage.loadError: Failed to load the erasure queue.
erasureRequestsPage.genericError: Failed to process the request. Please try again.
erasureRequestsPage.footerNote: Execution = pseudonymization of account data (identity → anonymous token) + session revocation + MFA removal. Organization activity records remain preserved.

step1.promptReject: Cancel the data erasure request for
step1.warningExecute: This action pseudonymizes the account data (identity → anonymous token), revokes all active sessions, and removes MFA. This cannot be undone.
step1.warningReject: The request will be rejected and will not be processed. The requester will be notified. This action is recorded in the audit trail.

header.title: PRODO Platform Console
header.description: Cross-organization access. No task, workspace, or project data is shown here. MFA required.

step1.title: Platform Admin Identity
step1.ssoNote: SSO is not available for Platform Admin accounts — credentials are managed directly by the PRODO operations team. Login attempts are recorded in the Platform Audit Trail.
